outcome_definition: RS_logit = Firth logistic-regression coefficient (log odds of reaction success) of holding a primer-template mismatch at the primer's 3' terminus instead of a Watson-Crick pair, versus a fully complementary primer binding site, with log(copy number) in the model. The response is a BINARY fluorescence-threshold call (successful / not), so this is not a fold change or a Cq shift. RS_p_star is the star string the supplement prints and '' means P >= 0.05 AS PRINTED, not 'no effect'. TMG/MG are robust-linear-mixed-model coefficients (same reference) on thereaction curve's time-to-maximum-gradient and maximum gradient. RS_probability = plogis(S1 intercept 4.79 + RS_logit); it reproduces the paper's printed 0.59 (C-C) and 0.62 (G-A).
